desc:
Inspired by Gartic Phone.

🎨 The BEST Drawing Game on Roblox! 🥇👑
Draw, guess & laugh with friends or new players!

🌀 Normal: words → drawings → guesses → reveal.
🤝 Co-op: take turns adding to a shared drawing.
👾 Exquisite Corpse: hidden body parts form one creature.
✨ More modes soon!

🛡️ Every drawing is checked by Roblox before anyone sees it.

💸 Robux Gifts: Roblox Plus required to send, not receive. Limits apply. Transfers are final. Parental approval may apply.

🕹️ 1–6: Tools • [ ]: Size
Ctrl+Z: Undo • Ctrl+Y/Ctrl+Shift+Z: Redo
Ctrl+D: Duplicate selection • Esc: Cancel
Wheel/pinch: Zoom
Right/middle mouse or 2-finger drag: Pan when zoomed
Shift/Ctrl: Snap angles & keep proportions

🎮 ALL devices supported now: PC, phones, tablets, consoles & VR!

👍 Like + favorite! 🐞 Feedback: group wall.
